item.title: SD Prompt Reader Available as ComfyUI Node and Desktop App
item.description:
SD Prompt Reader Available as ComfyUI Node and Desktop App

A simple standalone viewer for reading prompt from Stable Diffusion generated image outside the webui. The SD Prompt Reader is now available as a ComfyUI node.

🔍 Overview

The SD Prompt Reader provides both GUI and CLI. It allows you to perform the following actions:

  • Simple drag and drop interaction
  • Copy prompt to clipboard
  • Remove prompt from image
  • Export prompt to text file
  • Edit or import prompt to images

Vertical orientation display and sorting by alphabet are also included. Dark and light mode support is provided. For desktop builds from current source, see Building desktop applications. For Windows users, Download executable from GitHub Releases. For macOS users, Download executable from GitHub Releases. You may also install SD Prompt Reader via Homebrew cask. brew install –no-quarantine

🚀 Availability

RuinedFooocus PNG support is available in the development version only (#77). If you are using a tool or format that is not on this list, please help me to support your format by uploading the original file generated by your tool to the issues, thx.

⚙️ Key details

The following Safe Diffusion UIs are supported with specified formats.

Tool Supported Formats
A1111’s webUI PNG, JPEG, WEBP, TXT
Easy Diffusion PNG, JPEG, WEBP
StableSwarmUI PNG, JPEG (prior to 0.5.8-alpha)
Fooocus-MRE PNG, JPEG
ComfyUI PNG
Draw Things PNG
NovelAI (stealth pnginfo) PNG, WEBP
NovelAI (legacy) PNG
InvokeAI PNG (prior to 2.3.5-post.2 and prior to 1.15)
Naifu(4chan) PNG

Multi-format support includes PNG, JPEG, WEBP, and TXT. The ComfyUI Prompt Reader Node is a subproject of this project. It is recommended to embed the Prompt Saver node in the ComfyUI Prompt Reader Node within your workflow to ensure maximum compatibility.

💡 Why It Matters

Check out the ComfyUI Prompt Reader Node for more information on the node update.

🛠 Contribute

For macOS and Linux users, see GitHub Releases for executables. Support from A1111’s webUI in PNG, JPEG, WEBP, and TXT. Support from Easy Diffusion in PNG, JPEG, and WEBP. Support from StableSwarmUI in PNG and JPEG (prior to 0.5.8-alpha). Support from Fooocus-MRE in PNG and JPEG. Support from NovelAI in PNG, WEBP, and PNG only. Support from InvokeAI in PNG only (prior to 2.3.5-post.2 and prior to 1.15). Support from ComfyUI in PNG only. Support from Draw Things in PNG only. Support from Naifu(4chan) in PNG only.
